propositions: Pass-1 ladder entries are hardcoded as bare Anthropic model IDs (claude-haiku-4-5, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-8) which resolve to provider anthropic regardless of configured provider, causing cross-provider split-brain on entry and escalation

model_ladder[0] is copied directly to cfg.model in batch runners and DefaultBatchRunner.run without resolving class names, requiring wiring of class-name resolution at three separate ladder-consumption sites
models_at_or_above returns bare Anthropic ids for escalation even when called with Bedrock-qualified input, causing silent escalation to direct Anthropic in Bedrock-only environments

class names (trivial, standard, frontier) must be reserved vocabulary in the model-string space and resolved through resolve_model_string, which f844 already delivered and tested, with lazy import required in config.resolve_model to avoid circular dependency

MODEL_LADDER holds both escalation order and P8 context-window budget via substring match; naive class-name substitution would break window lookups by making substring matches always fail, requiring models_at_or_above to map rungs through class config while keeping MODEL_LADDER and largest_window_tokens unchanged
config.py must not import model_classes at module level due to the reverse import at model_classes module scope, forcing lazy import inside resolve_model function body
